definitions.explanation: The systematic design and regulation of land use, infrastructure, and development within a city or urban area. In Japan, governed by the City Planning Act (都市計画法).

examples.japanese: {都市計画|としけいかく}を{見直|みなお}す。
{新|あたら}しい{都市計画|としけいかく}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: A new urban plan was announced.

examples.japanese: {都市計画|としけいかく}に{基|もと}づいて、この{地域|ちいき}は{商業|しょうぎょう}{地区|ちく}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: Based on the city plan, this area has been designated as a commercial district.

notes:
Compound of {都市|とし} (city, urban area) and {計画|けいかく} (plan, planning). In Japan, urban planning is regulated by the {都市計画法|としけいかくほう} (City Planning Act), which divides land into various use zones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都市計画|としけいかく}{法|ほう} — City Planning Act
- {都市計画|としけいかく}{区域|くいき} — city planning zone
- {都市計画|としけいかく}{道路|どうろ} — planned road (road designated in an urban plan)
- {都市計画|としけいかく}を{策定|さくてい}する — to formulate an urban plan

RELATED WORDS:
- {用途地域|ようとちいき} — zoning district; land use zone
- {区画整理|くかくせいり} — land readjustment; lot replotting
- {再開発|さいかいはつ} — redevelopment
- {街|まち}づくり — town development; community building
